About Camak

Local roots.
A higher standard of care.

We’re a professional cleaning company based in Avenal, Invercargill, looking after homes and businesses across Southland.

Local people.
Local care.INVERCARGILL & SOUTHLAND
A clean space is a better space

Built on trust.
Driven by the details.

Camak Services Limited was founded with one purpose: to deliver dependable, detail-driven cleaning that improves the spaces our clients live and work in.

We combine modern equipment, proven cleaning methods and eco-conscious product options. From cosy family homes to busy commercial premises, every job gets the same care and professionalism.

  • Trained and briefed cleaning professionals
  • Quality commercial-grade equipment
  • Eco-friendly product options on request
  • Clear communication and transparent pricing
  • Insured, reliable service delivery
Our mission

Better spaces. Better days.

To provide reliable, high-quality cleaning that makes Southland homes and businesses healthier, more productive and more enjoyable — every visit.

Our vision

Southland’s trusted cleaning partner.

To be known for friendliness, integrity, eco-conscious practices and the kind of attention to detail our clients can rely on.
